targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: Do NOT set substrate_ceiling. The substrate is implemented/available; the fix is harness-side (arm the flag + structured stimulus + non-vacuity guards).
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-688 (3 seeds, 2026-06-18) FAIL/non_contributory was a precondition_unmet vacuous self-route, NOT a substrate-readiness verdict: G1 V_s_responsive read per_stream_vs.get('z_world',1.0) while the harness left use_per_stream_vs=False, forcing vs_change=0.0 by construction; G2 boundary_events_fire fed the MECH-288 segmenter i.i.d. white noise (no structured transition) -> 0 events. MECH-269/MECH-288 substrate is implemented and available; the experiment harness simply did not arm/stimulate it. MECH-044 was never put under test. Routed to V3-EXQ-688a (arm use_per_stream_vs, structured-stimulus G2, non-vacuity + discriminative-encoder guards). NOT substrate_ceiling.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: No substrate gap. MECH-269 per_stream_vs and MECH-288 EventSegmenter are implemented and available in V3; the failure is a harness config (use_per_stream_vs unset) + probe-stimulus (white noise) defect. The fix is a re-issued experiment, not a substrate entry.

self_route_adjudication.reason: Both failing preconditions are guaranteed-fail artifacts of the config (G1 reads a flag-gated observable with the flag off -> constant default; G2 stimulus cannot elicit the gated signal), so the label carries no information about MECH-269/MECH-288 readiness.

learning_extracted: A readiness gate that reads a flag-gated observable (per_stream_vs) without arming the flag (use_per_stream_vs) is a vacuous instrumentation null -- it tests harness config, not the substrate.
Probing a structured-transition detector (MECH-288) with i.i.d. white noise guarantees a 0-event null; readiness probes must use the experiment-body class of stimulus.
The substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route was untrustworthy by construction; the precondition_unmet adjudication gate correctly held it.

Untrained agent + synthetic obs cannot fairly test relational binding even past a fixed readiness gate; the successor needs a discriminative-encoder / boundary-existence-proof non-vacuity guard on the C1-C3 body.

successor_spec.id_rule: new alphabetic suffix (bug-fix, same scientific question MECH-044); do NOT re-run under V3-EXQ-688 (runner skips completed ids)
fixes: Arm use_per_stream_vs=True in _build_agent (and per_stream_vs_streams covering z_world) so G1 measures the real MECH-269 V_s signal.
Redesign G2 to drive the MECH-288 segmenter with the structured relational/absolute manipulation (or a sustained step change), not torch.randn white noise.

Add non-vacuity prerequisites: assert per_stream_vs non-empty post-arm; require a boundary-event existence proof on the structured stimulus; gate the C1-C3 body on a discriminative-z_world check; self-route honestly when un-armed/untrained.
Use a trained/warmed encoder for the relational-sensitivity body (or document why an untrained module is the intended test surface).
